subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: Test count decreased: 5 live preview tests were removed and only 3 re-added (net -2, total dropped from 22 to 20). The removed tests 'should call setHost with CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset' and 'should not call setHost when neither CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST nor CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is set' covered important fallback behavior. Review criteria explicitly requires the total test count not decrease.
issues.suggestedFix: Re-add the two removed tests for setHost fallback to CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST and for no setHost call when neither host env var is set. These cover edge cases that the 3 retained tests do not.

issues.description: No test verifies that setCommonConfig forwards live_preview/preview_hash to Contentstack queries via addParam. The addParam mock was added to the mock Stack (line 34) but is never asserted against in any test. AC #3 requires that 'preview context (live_preview/preview_hash) can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig' — this code path is completely untested.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry or getSingleEntry with a live_preview config (e.g., { live_preview: { enable: true, preview_hash: 'abc123' } }) and asserts that query.addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'true') and ('preview_hash', 'abc123').

issues.description: contentstack.Stack(options as any) introduces an untyped 'any' cast without an explanatory comment. While the file has a top-level /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */, the new 'as any' on the Stack constructor bypasses all type checking on the entire options object. The previous code used a more targeted 'as unknown as contentstack.LivePreview' cast only on the live_preview spread.
issues.suggestedFix: Either type the options object to match contentstack.Stack's expected Config type, or use a targeted cast with an inline comment explaining the type mismatch (e.g., '// Contentstack SDK types do not include live_preview in Config'). Avoid casting the entire options object to any.

issues.description: (query as any).addParam(...) uses untyped 'any' casts (twice) to call addParam, which is not in the contentstack.Query type. This hand-rolls parameter forwarding instead of using any SDK-provided method. If addParam is not in the SDK types, the cast should include an explanatory comment per TypeScript strict compliance rules.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an inline comment explaining why the cast is needed (e.g., '// addParam is available at runtime but not in SDK type definitions'). Alternatively, check if the Contentstack SDK provides a typed method for adding preview parameters.

issues.description: Interface shape change removes the 'live_preview?: string' property from ICommonContentstackConfig.live_preview, replacing it with 'enable?: boolean'. The old shape { live_preview?: string; preview_hash?: string } allowed callers to forward a live_preview hash string; the new shape { enable?: boolean; preview_hash?: string } drops that capability. setCommonConfig now hardcodes addParam('live_preview', 'true') instead of reading a value from config. Any external callers passing the old shape will fail to compile.
issues.suggestedFix: If this is intentional, document the breaking change. If backward compatibility is needed, consider keeping live_preview?: string alongside enable?: boolean and preview_hash?: string.
